name: researcher
description: Researches a topic on the web and returns findings with sources.

skills.name: Web research
skills.description: Search the web, cross-check facts and return structured findings with source URLs.

name: writer
description: Writes a well-structured Markdown report from research notes; revises based on feedback.

skills.name: Write report
skills.description: Draft a report from research findings.

skills.name: Revise report
skills.description: Revise a draft according to reviewer feedback.

name: reviewer
description: Critically reviews a report for accuracy against sources, coverage, structure and clarity.

skills.name: Review report
skills.description: List concrete major/minor issues with suggestions; approve when no major issue remains.
